They are made by gathering poison from the luminious mushroom within the encounter.

Players who did not previously obtain a snow globe could get one during the 2016 Christmas event by talking to the Queen of Snow after stepping through the 2007 Christmas cupboard.
It was made by combining a blue charm with 51 spirit shards and a Potato cactus.

sc: Springtime Dungaree Bottoms (Daisy) is a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked through the Egg Hunt promotion from Treasure Hunter.
The starfire magic boots are an item that can be bought from the DXP Token Store, the Portable Trader or made by combining 2,000 starlight ore during the promotion period.
The stick is an item that players must retrieve in the Werewolf Agility Course in order to obtain the course's lap bonus.
Once obtained, players have to complete the course to be able to give the stick to the agility boss and start the process again.
If for some reason a player manages to obtain multiple sticks, handing one in will result in all sticks in the player's inventory to be exchanged for the same amount of experience as only 1 stick.
The summoning crate (small) is an item that can be won from the Squeal of Fortune which contains a variety of summoning materials; there is also a chance for an additional reward.
An Ugly Duckling (beach cocktail) is an item that can be created with an advanced cocktail kit during The Beach events since The Beach in 2021 and as a drop from Clawdia since The Beach in 2022.
Previously, it could also be obtained by participating in various beach activities during the summer events between 2022 and 2025.
The underwater disguise kit is obtained by using delicious seaweed on the goebie disguise kit, as part of the Mod Deg trading sequence.
Unheated poison detection potion (strange spices) can be created by mixing a base poison detection potion and unidentified spices during Murder on the Border.
Untamed Staff is a two-handed magic weapon cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing the Untamed Magic Weapon Pack.
It was made by combining a blue charm with 74 spirit shards and a Shifter charm.

Spirit gems, which are dropped by all monsters that drop a single charm and could be received from the Squeal of Fortune, functioned similarly to Runecrafting pouches and stored uncharged summoning pouches before an update.
It is used to assist Pikkupstix in summoning a giant wolpertinger, and is received from Taverley's pet shop owner.
White oak is an Archaeological material that can be obtained through excavating material caches or various excavation sites, requiring level 17 Archaeology, at various dig sites around Gielinor.
The wyrmfire potion is a combination potion that can be made at level 89 Herblore after unlocking the recipe.
It is made by combining an antifire (4) and a super antifire (4) into a crystal flask, giving 275.
